dhammasīsa:
1dhamma
m. (and n.) [S., BHS dharma], dhamma denotes (an interpretation of) the essential nature and reality of existence and experience, the way things are: it is descriptive and prescriptive; it denotes also an essential attribute of men or animals; a quality or characteristic; Abh 784 (~o sabhāve pariyattipaññāñāyesu saccappakatīsu puññe ñeyye guṇācārasamādhisū pi nissattatāpattisu kāraṇādo); see also Sv 99,.3 foll., Ps I 17,.16 foll., It-a I 37,.20 foll., Paṭis-a 18,.1 foll., Bv-a 13,.4 foll., As 38,.23 foll. and Sadd 560,.25 foll.; — for Buddhists dhamma is used to denote an interlocking and interdependent assembly of concepts: the true nature of the world of experience, how that world works, and the way to transcend it, as understood by the Buddha; the progressive stages of understanding and nibbāna ; the behaviour, the practice, required to achieve understanding of the way the world of experience works, ie the way to reach arhatship, nibbāna ; the understanding and practice taught by the Buddha, the substance of his teaching, the texts of the Canon, especially the Suttapiṭaka ; all constituents of the world of experience, physical and mental, external and internal, progressively more and more minutely analysed; all constituents of prescribed practice, appropriate and beneficial actions; prescriptions for the members of the saṅgha ; — for people generally dhamma is an interpretation of the essential nature of existence and experience; the way one should act, depending on who one is, to maintain the way things are and should be; duty; right; justice; normative and beneficial actions; — 1. (i) how the world of experience works, the processes by which it works and is explained (especially as formulated in cattāri ariyasaccāni and paṭiccasamuppāda ), and the possibility and way of transcending it, as understood by the Buddha and taught by him (so that knowledge and understanding of it might bring enlightenment, arhatship, to others); Vin I 2,3* (yadā have pātubhavanti ~ā ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa ath’ assa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā yato pajānāti sahetudhammaṃ; Sp 954,.19 foll. : pātubhavantī ti uppajjanti ~ā ti anulomapaccayākārapaṭivedhasādhakā bodhipakkhiyadhammā, atha vā pātubhavantī ti pakāsenti abhisamayavasena vyattā pākaṭā honti, ~ā ti caturāriyasaccadhammā); 11,.2 (idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu ~esu cakkhuṃ udapādi); 12,.24 (ehi bhikkhū ti bhagavā avoca svākkhāto ~o cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā ti); 15,.31 (idaṃ kho Yasa anupaddutaṃ idaṃ anupassaṭṭhaṃ ehi Yasa nisīda ~aṃ te desessāmī ti); 40,.19 foll. (ahaṃ kho āvuso navo acirappabbajito adhunāgato imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ na t’ ahaṃ sakkomi vitthārena ~aṃ desituṃ api ca te saṅkhittena atthaṃ vakkhāmī ti … ye ~ā hetuppabhavā tesaṃ hetuṃ tathāgato āha tesaṃ ca yo nirodho evaṃvādī mahāsamaṇo; Sp 975,.19 : ye ~ā hetuppabhavā ti hetuppabhavā nāma pañcakkhandhā); III 1,.18 (iti pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho … so imaṃ lokaṃ … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti so ~aṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ …); D I 62,.24 foll. n. gharā, m.pl. [AMg, BHS ghara], (gharaṃ, gharā in sg. sense; gharā, gharāni in pl. sense; see also jarāgharo sv jara1) 1. a building, a house; esp. the household of a layman, living a worldly life in a family; Abh 206 (~aṃ); Vin III 181,.15 (ehi bhante ~aṃ gamissāmā ti); IV 66,.28 (~ato ca nikkaḍḍhi); 311,.6 (amhākaṃ ~āni āgantvā); S I 37,4* foll. (kiṃ su mittaṃ sake ~e … mātā mittaṃ sake ~e); Dhp 241 (asajjhāyamalā mantā anuṭṭhānamalā ~ā); Sn 43 (gahaṭṭhā ~am āvasantā); 337 (saddhāya ~ā nikkhamma); 899 (satthā va hīno pavasaṃ ~amhā); Pv 21:7 (yass’ ekarattiṃ pi ~e vaseyya); 27:22 (na manusseseu īdisā yādisā no ~ā idha); Th 712 (ādittā va ~ā mutto); Thī 18 (hitvā ~e pabbajitvā; Thī-a 23,.8 : ~e ti gehaṃ, °-saddo hi ekasmiṃ pi abhidheyye kadāci bahūsu bījaṃ viya rūḷhivasena voharīyati); 420 (atha maṃ adāsi tāto aḍḍhassa ~amhi); Ja II 232,17* (sukhā ~ā Vacchanakha sahiraññā sabhojanā); IV 371,15* (bharāmi putte dāre ca ~esu gathito ahaṃ); V 82,20* (hitvā ~aṃ pabbajito acelo); VI 301,21* (katvā ~esu kiccāni anusāsitvā sakaṃ ~aṃ); Ap 274,.13 (pitu ~e, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce gahe); Mil 47,.19 (tiṇaṃ jhāyamānaṃ ~aṃ jhāpeyya); Kv 329,.24 (ākāsaṃ parivāretvā ~āni karonti); Vism 663,13*; Sp 652,.25 (~e ti °-paricchedo ekakulassa nivesanaṃ hotī ti); 1007,.2 (kiṃ uppaṭipāṭiyā issarajanānaṃ ~āni agamaṃsu); Cp-a 154,.8 (yassa gharadvāre evaṃ nipajjitvā caṇḍālo marati tena ~ena saddhiṃ sattasattagharavāsino caṇḍālā hontī ti); 206,.21 (pañcakāmaguṇasamiddhaṃ ~am eva āvasatu); Mhv 37:11 (bhinditvā Lohapāsādaṃ sattabhūmikam uttamaṃ ~e nānappakāre ca ito ’bhayagiriṃ nayuṃ); Sadd 858,.29 (gaha icc etassa dhātussa gharādeso hoti vā ṇapaccaye pare ti … ~aṃ ~āni); — ghare karoti, brings home as a wife; marries; Ja I 290,.5 (pariyesitvā purisantaraṃ agataṃ ekaṃ mātugāmaṃ ~e karissāmī ti); V 226,11´ (sace hi ahaṃ viya añño rājā tava bhariyāya paṭibaddhacitto abhavissa … tava sīsaṃ chindāpetvā taṃ attano ~e kareyya); 442,.23; Dhp-a I 45,.20 (kumārikaṃ … tassa ~e akāsi); — suññaṃ/suññakaṃ gharaṃ, solitude; Ap 273,.7 (maṇḍape rukkhamūle vā vasato suññake ~e); 326,.7 (suññe ~e maṇḍaparukkhamūlake vasāmi niccaṃ sukhito anāsavo); Sv 360,.5 (suññāgāre ti suññe ghare, ekeko va nisīditvā ti adhippāyo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee suññaghare); — gharam in Ee at Ja VI 448,13* is wr for saram (Be, Ce, Se so); — ifc see anto-, andu-, apāruta- (sv apāpurati), āsana- (sv āsana2), odanika-, odanī̆ya- (sv odaniya2), kārā-, cetiya-, jantāghara, jarā- (sv jara1), paṭimā-, bodhi-, bhattiya-, sayani-, surā-, sūti-; — 2. a floor or storey of a building;? S V 452,.13 (ahaṃ kūṭāgārassa heṭṭhimaṃ ~aṃ akaritvā uparimaṃ ~aṃ āropessāmī ti; Spk III 301,.16 : thambhabhitti-pādussāpanādinā ~assa heṭṭhimabhāgaṃ akatvā); — 3. a case; a container; — ifc see kuñcikā-, sūci-; —      ° âjira,   n., a house-yard; Vism 144,.4 (ghare ohīyitvā ~e ṭhatvā); —       °’-āvāsa,   m., living in a house; household, family life; Vin I 197,.5 (ciraṃ diṭṭho me bhante kāmesu ādīnavo api ca sambādhā ~ā bahukiccā bahukaraṇīyā ti); D I 63,.3 (sambādho ~o rajopatho abbhokāso pabbajjā); A III 295,.22 (na sakkoti dārake posetuṃ ~aṃ santharitun ti); Sn 406; Ud 59,.31; Ja I 61,.8 (mayā ~aṃ chaḍḍetvā nikkhamma pabbajitvā nibbānaṃ gavesituṃ vaṭṭati); Ps III 247,.29 (~e ādīnavaṃ brahmacariyavāse ānisaṃsaṃ ca dassetvā); Pv-a 61,.3 (na dāni me ~ena attho abhiramissāmi brahmacariyavāse ti); —       °’-āsavā ti    in Ee at Ja IV 223,22´ is prob. wr; Be kirātan ti; Ce, Se kirāsan cā ti); —        °’ ū̆pacāra,   m.n., the immediate surroundings of a house, the ground belonging to a house; Vin III 46,.29 (aparikkhittassa gāmassa ~e ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto); IV 100,.25; Vism 72,.10; Spk II 356,.7 (manussānaṃ hi antogharaṃ viya cha ajjhattikāyatanāni ~aṃ viya cha bāhirāyatanāni); —        °-kapota,   m., a domestic pigeon; Mil 364,.6 (~assa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee °-kapoṭassa; Se °-kapotakassa); 403,.3 (yathā mahārāja ~o paragehe vasamāno na tesaṃ kiñci bhaṇḍassa nimittaṃ gaṇhāti majjhatto vasati saññābahulo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °-kapoṭo); —       °-golikā,   °-goḷikā,   f., a house-lizard; Abh 621 (sarabū ~ā); Ja II 147,15´; Sv 92,.14 (~āya makkhikā gahetvā muttā); Mp III 104,.4; —        °-dāsa, m.,,        °-dāsī,   f. [ghara + dāsa1, dāsī], a domestic slave; a house-slave; Pv 15:21 (~iyo); Ja V 436,2´ (~īhi saddhiṃ saṃvasati); Sp 1000,.21 (antojāto nāma jātidāso ~iyā putto); Sv 157,.13 (dāsakaputtā ti balavasinehā °-dāsayodhā, Ce, Ee so; Se dāsikaputtā ti … °-dāsikaputtā); —        °-dinnakābādha,   m., a sickness caused by a magic potion given in a house;? Vin I 206,.19 (aññatarassa bhikkhuno ~o hoti … anjānāmi bhikkhave sītāloḷiṃ pāyetun ti; Sp 1092,.14 : ~o ti vasī-karaṇapānakasamuṭṭhitarogo; Sp-ṭ [Be] III 304,.14 : ~o nāma vasīkaraṇatthāya gharaṇiyā dinna-bhesajjasamuṭṭhito ābādho … gharasaddo c’ ettha abhedena gharaṇiyā vattamāno adhippeto); —       °-dhūpana,   n. [ghara + dhūpana2], perfuming or fumigating the house; Sp 716,.3 (~’-ādīsu upanetabbaṃ); 718,.21; —       °-paṭipāṭi,   f., a series or (regular) succession of houses; Sp 624,.27 (~i pi vīthippamāṇā va hotī ti); Nidd-a II 144,.14 (~iṃ achaḍḍetvā aḍḍhakulaṃ ca daḷiddakulaṃ ca nirantaraṃ piṇḍāya pavisamāno); — °-paṭipāṭiyā, adv., successively from house to house, from house to house in order; Ja V 253,12´; Vism 343,.14 (kapālahatthena ~iyā gāmavīthīsu caritabbaṃ hoti); Sp 207,.5 (~iyā bhikkhāya pavisati); Ps I 148,.29 (~iyā carantassa); Pj II 278,.27 (manussā … puna ~iyā ekekadivasaṃ dānaṃ adaṃsu); —       °-bandhana,   n. (and m.) 1. confinement in a house, detention; Vin III 47,.9 (saṅkhalikabandhanena vā ~ena vā nagarabandhanena vā … bandheyyuṃ); — 2. the bondage of the household life; marriage; Ja V 312,.29 (brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇiṃ āmantetvā bhoti puttaṃ Sonakumāraṃ ~ena bandhissāmā ti āha); Dhp-a I 4,.6 (te vayapatte ~ena bandhiṃsu); Ud-a 70,.22; Th-a I 93,.23 (~e chinditvā pabbaji); —       °-mesi(n)    (interpreted by cts as °-m-esi[n]), m (fn). [cf S. gṛhamedhin], a householder; S I 215,3* (yass’ ete caturo dhammā saddhassa ~ino; Spk I 333,.14 foll. : gharāvāsaṃ pañca vā kāmaguṇe esantassa gavesantassa kāmabhogino gahaṭṭhassa) = Sn 188; A III 354,14* (saddhassa ~ino; Mp III 377,.15 : gharāvāsaṃ pariyesantass’ eva vasamānassa vā); It 112,6* (sugataṃ pana nissāya gahaṭṭhā ~ino; It-a II 163,.23 : ~ino ti gharaṃ esino, gehe ṭhatvā gharāvāsaṃ vasantā bhogūpakaraṇāni c’ eva gahaṭṭhasīlādīni ca esanasīlā ti attho); Pv 21:28 (Pv-a 124,.9 : ~ino ti gharaṃ āvasantassa gahaṭṭhassa); Ja VI 575,14* (dukkaṭaṃ vata bho raññā saddhena ~inā; 575,20´ : gharaṃ āvasantena); —       °-vicāraka,   m., one who looks after houses; Ja I 364,.27 (sace ajja evarūpo buddhi-sampanno ~o nābhavissa corehi … sabbaṃ gehaṃ viluttaṃ assa; see 364,.18 : taṃ geharakkhakaṃ katvā agamāsi); —       °-sappa,   m., a kind of (non-poisonous) snake, a rat-snake; Abh 652 (silutto ~o); Ja I 372,.17 (~aṃ viya taṃ yugasāṭakaṃ yaṭṭhikoṭiyā gahetvā, Se so; Be ajagarasappaṃ; Ce, Ee agārasappaṃ); VI 194,18´ (siluttassā ti ~assa); Dhp-a II 256,.21 (nāyaṃ āsīviso ~o ti); —       °-sāmika,   m., a householder; Ja IV 28,.26 (eko coro … paṭibuddhehi ~ehi c’ eva ārakkhamanussehi ca anubaddho); Vism 664,.11; Ps II 318,.21; Spk I 325,.17 (~o viya itthāgārassa majjhe nisinno si); —        °-(s)sāminī,   f., a housewife; the wife of a householder; Sp 532,.21 (kulitthiyo nāma ~iyo, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr gharā-sāmiyo); Ps II 98,.33 (gahapatānī ti ~ī); Pv-a 276,.18 (taṃ attano jeṭṭhaputtassa ~iṃ akāsi); — see also saghara (sv sa5).
ghātayati:
ghāteti, ~ayati
pr. 3 sg. [S. ghātayati; denom. from ghāta qv, used sometimes as caus. of hanati qv], strikes; kills, slays, puts to death; causes to kill or be killed; Vin III 74,.37 (evaṃ vijjha evaṃ pahara evaṃ ~ehī ti); IV 308,.19 (iminā Kappitakena amhākaṃ ayyāya thūpo bhinno handa naṃ ~emā ti); Dhp 405 (yo na hanti na ~eti; Dhp-a IV 176,.3 : n’ eva kañci sayaṃ hanti na aññe ~eti) = Sn 629; Ja I 175,.16 (diṭṭhadiṭṭhaṭṭhāne sunakhe ~ethā ti); IV 449,17* (bālāyaṃ bālassa vāco nisamma ahetunā ~ayate janindo); V 182,22* (~emi kaṃ avajjhaṃ ñātīnam udikkhamānānaṃ); VI 139,20* (atha no akāraṇasmā yaññatthāya deva ~esi); 491,10* (kathaṃ Vessantaraṃ puttaṃ satthena ~ayāmase; 491,12´ : ~āmase ti ~essāmi, Ce, Ee so; Be ~ayissāma; Se ~essāma); Nidd I 216,.24 (kodho parapuggalaṃ ~etvā attānaṃ ~eti); Mil 278,.14 (suriyo atippabhātāya timiraṃ ~eti); Sp 54,.2 (paccantaṃ vūpasamentā core ~enti); Mp I 369,.20 (rājā imaṃ coraṃ dakkhiṇadvārena nīharitvā ~ethā ti āha); Dhp-a II 43,.14 (rājā maṃ ~etu vā raṭṭhato pabbājetu vā); Mhv 7:35 (ajjeva yakkhe ~ehi); 7:36 (tattha saddaṃ karissāmi tena saddena ~aya); Sadd 398,.19 (vadhati vadheti ~eti icc api rūpāni bhavanti); — opt. 3 sg. (a) ghāteyya, Ja VI 140,2* (anantaraṃ pi taṃ deva ~eyya); Ps III 345,.3; Spk III 61,.13 (caṇḍo kumāro ~eyyāpi man ti); (b) ghātaye, Dhp 129 (na haneyya na ~aye); Sn 705; Ja VI 140,1* (mā tassa saddahesi na maṃ Khaṇḍahālo ~aye, Ce, Ee so, prob. wr; Be, Se ~eyya); (c) ghātayeyya, Sn 394 (pāṇaṃ na hane na ca ~ayeyya); 3 pl. ghāteyyuṃ, Nidd I 397,.8 (heṭheyyuṃ viheṭheyyuṃ ~eyyuṃ upaghāteyyuṃ); Sv 801,.19; — fut. 3 sg. (a) ghātessati, Ja VI 424,22´; Cp-a 255,.12 (ayaṃ maṃ kin nu kho ~essati udāhu no ti); (b) ghātayissati, Ja VI 424,18*; Cp 3:12:6; 1 sg. (a) ghātessaṃ, Ja VI 137,8* (~essaṃ Candaṃ ca Suriyaṃ ca, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~issaṃ); — ghātessaṃ in Ce, Ee at Ja I 255,.5 (yan-nūnāhaṃ … ~essan ti) is prob. wr for ghāteyyan ti (Be, Se so); (b) ghātessāmi, Vin IV 225,.26 (mayhaṃ pajāpati aticarati taṃ ~essāmī ti); Ps III 329,.21; (c) ghātayissaṃ, Ja VI 137,12´ (Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ~essaṃ); (d) ghātayissāmi, Ja VI 151,28*; Cp 2:6:10; — part.pr. (a) ghātenta, mfn., Vin III 89,.30 (hananto ~ento chindanto chedāpento …); Ja V 231,.15; Ps II 29,.11 (bahusu pi manussesu ekam eva pāṇaṃ ~entesu); Spk III 268,.2 (attano pi sāvake aññamaññaṃ ~ente nivāretuṃ na sakkoti); — neg. aghātenta, mfn., Ja III 203,11*; (b) neg. aghātaya(t), mfn., S I 116,.19 (sakkā nu kho rajjaṃ kāretuṃ ahanaṃ aghātayaṃ …, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se aghātanaṃ) quoted Dhp-a IV 32,.1; (c) neg. aghātayanta, mfn., Spk I 180,.28 (ahanantena aghātayantena, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se aghāṭentena); (d) ghātayamāna, mfn., Ja I 256,12´ (anavasesā aññamaññaṃ ~ayamānā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee aññaṃ); — aor. 3 sg. (a) ghātesi, Ja VI 141,15*; Mil 201,.15; Sp 41,.23 (te sabbe Asoko … Tissakumāraṃ ṭhapetvā ~esi); Ps V 62,.24 (siṅgena vijjhitvā ~esi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ghāṭesi); (b) ghātayi, aghātayi, Sn 308 (rājā … gāvo yaññe aghātayi); 309 (tā visāṇe gahetvāna rājā satthena ~ayi); Ap 490,.6 (~ayi); Mhv 7:37 (aghātayi); 2 sg. (a) ghātesi, aghātesi, Ja III 176,12´ (yo tvaṃ mama dubbalāya puttake vadhi ~esī ti); VI 150,5* (mā tāta no aghātesi); (b) ghātayi, aghātayi, Ja V 69,13* (kaṃ avajjhaṃ aghātayi); VI 142,3* (mā ~ayi orasaṃ puttaṃ); (c) ghātayittha1, Sp 588,.31 (tvaṃ … manussaṃ ~ayittha); (d) ghātayesi, Ja VI 139,21* (pubbe va no daharake na hanesi na ~ayesi, None L. Alsdorf, 1968, p. 41 so; Be, Se daharakāle … na ~esi; Ce daharake samāne … na ~ayesi; Ee daharake ca samāne … na ~ayesi; 140,.22 foll. ´: kasmā sayaṃ vā na hanesi aññehi vā na ~āpesi); 3 pl. (a) ghātesuṃ, aghātesuṃ, Ja III 177,15* (ete nāgaṃ aghātesuṃ; 177,19´ : aghātesun ti vadhiṃsu); Sv 153,.27 (Nāgadāsaṃ … raṭṭhavāsino kupitā ~esuṃ); (b) aghātayuṃ, Ja IV 211,3* (aññamaññaṃ vivādena aññamaññaṃ aghātayuṃ; 211,10´ : aghātayun ti ~āpesuṃ); (c) ghātayiṃsu, Ja I 254,.28; As 245,.19; 2 pl. ghātayittha2, Ja VI 491,16´ (mā tumhe … ~ayittha); — inf. (a) ghātetuṃ, M II 122,.1; Ja IV 192,19* (na itthi-kāraṇā rāja puttaṃ ~etum arahasi); Sp 56,.14; b) ghātayituṃ, Mil 186,.17; (c) ghātuṃ? Ap-a 562,.31 (kammaṃ asodhetvā ghātukāmattā va jīvantam eva taṃ sūle uttāsesi); — absol. (a) ghātetvā, Ja I 166,.26; Vism 602,.1 (sayaṃ kusalaṃ pi akusalaṃ pi samānaṃ aññaṃ dubbalakammaṃ ~etvā); Sp 998,.32 (jānūhi va kapparehi vā nāḷikerapāsāṇādīhi vā ~etvā); Ps IV 61,.3 (khuddakamige ~etvā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ghāṭetvā); Cp-a 249,.6; Mhv 25:7 (~etvā Damiḷe); (b) ghātetvāna, Ja VI 140,2*; (c) ghātayitvā, Mil 219,.16; As 245,s; —     pass. pr. 3 sg.     ghātī̆yati,   Mil 186,.14 (yo so mahāraja ~ati); Ps II 332,.16 (~antu); V 31,.26 (upahaññatī ti ~ati); — part.pr. ghātī̆yamāna, mfn., Ja I 175,.17 (te diṭṭha-diṭṭhaṭṭhāne ~amānā palāyitvā …); Ps II 133,.24 (ime sattā … kilesakāmehi ~amānā); —      pp     ghātita,   mfn., struck; killed; Ja I 167,.10 (~-ttā); Sp 1023,.6 (mātā ~ā); Ps III 349,.18 (me mātulo adosakārako nikkāraṇena ~o ti); V 88,.17 (ghātessāma ne ti cintetvā idh’ eva ~esu sabbaṃ vanaṃ ekaṃ kuṇapaṃ bhavissati, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee wr ghāṭitesu); Ud-a 265,12* (macchake ~e disvā); Thī-a 262,.33 (yaṃ ca paccatthikehi ~ānaṃ rudhiraṃ); Mhv 25:109 (diyaḍḍhamanujā v’ ettha ~ā); — ghātite in Ee at Sp 1106,.8 is wr for ghaṭite (Be, Ce, Se so); — neg. aghātita, mfn., Sv 926,.6 (paresaṃ aghātitabhāvaṃ); —      fpp (a) ghātetabba,   mfn., Mil 186,.10 (coro … bandh-aniyo bandhitabbo ghātanīyo ~o ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ghātitabbo ti); 407,.16 (yoginā yogāvacarena … kilesa-makkhikā … tatth’ eva ~ā); Ps III 413,.21 (mātaraṃ pi pitaraṃ pi ghātetvā attā va ~o ti, Be, Se so; Ce jotetabbo ti; Ee wr ghāṭetvā); Cp-a 61,.2 (yajanā mutto ti Khaṇḍa-hāḷena vihitayaññavidhito vuttanayena ~ato mutto); — neg. aghātetabba, mfn., Ja V 182,26´ (aghātetabbaṃ, Be Ce, Ee so; Se aghāṭetabbaṃ); (b) ghātanī̆ya, mfn., Mil 186,.10; (c) ghātetāya, mfn., M I 231,.2 (vatteyya rañño … vaso ghātetāyaṃ vā ghātetuṃ jāpetāyaṃ vā jāpetuṃ pabbājetāyaṃ vā pabbājetuṃ; Ps II 276,.34 : ghātārahaṃ ghātetabbayuttaṃ ghātetuṃ) ≠ II 122,.1; (d) ghacca; — see sv ghaccā; —      caus. pr. 3 sg.     ghātāpeti,   Vin I 277,.7 (caṇḍāyaṃ rājā ~eyyāpi maṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr ~eyyāsi); 343,.36 (sabbe va tayo ~essati); Ja IV 124,.26 (putte ~eyyā ti); V 230,.25 (sve ~etha naṃ mahārājā ti); Cp 3:2:9 (~emi); Sv 318,.3 (attano putte jāte sattakkhattuṃ ~etuṃ upakkami, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ghātetuṃ) = Ps II 390,.25 (Ce, Ee so; Be, Se mārāpetuṃ); — part.pr. ghātāpenta, mfn., Dhp-a I 359,.5; — aor. 3 sg. ghātāpesi, Ja VI 140,23´; 3 pl. ghātāpesuṃ, Ja IV 211,10´; — absol. ghātāpetvā, Ja I 260,.23 (sahassaṃ ~etvā); Vibh-a 442,.27; — pp ghātāpita, mfn., Sp 1277,.20 (rañño ~itattā); — fpp ghātāpetabba, mfn., Cp-a 191,.15 (kumāro nāsiyo nāsetabbo ~etabbo).
giddhigata:
giddhi
f. [AMg id.; BHS gṛddhi; cf S. gṛdhyā], greed; hungry desire; Ja V 343,14* (hotu ~i tavāsmasu; 343,20´ : mayi lobhaṃ uppādehī ti vadati); Pj II 118,.7 (gedhaṃ akaran ti ~iṃ akaronto taṇhaṃ anuppādento ti attho) = Nidd-a II 144,.3 (Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~iṃ gedhanaṃ) = Ap-a 192,.27 (Be, Ce, Se so; Ee giddhaṃ, prob. wr); Sadd 487,.15 (lubha ~iyaṃ); —      °-gata,   mfn., eagerly desiring; Ja IV 329,19* (ahaṃ pure ~o kapotiyā); —       °-ma(t),   mfn., full of greed; eagerly desiring; — ifc see kāma-, rasa-; — agiddhima(t), mfn., not greedy; Ja II 294,8´ (agiddhitā pi sādhu, pāḷiyaṃ pana agiddhimā ti likhitaṃ, tato ayaṃ aṭṭhakathāpāṭho va sundarataro, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce agiddhatā pi sādhu); —       °-māna,   m. (or n.) [giddhi + māna1], greed and pride; Sn 328 (kuhanaṃ ~aṃ … hitvā; Pj II 334,.19 : paccayesu giddhi jāti-ādīhi māno); —       °-lobha,   m., greed and covetousness; greedy desire; M I 360,.25 (agiddhilobhaṃ nissāya ~o pahātabbo; Ps III 39,.4 : gedhabhūto lobho pahātabbo); Ps III 41,.14 (appamattakaṃ pi ~aṃ akaraṇasāsane pabbajitvā); — agiddhilobha, m., freedom from greed and covetousness; M I 360,.25; —       °-lobhi(n),   mfn., greedy and covetous; greedily desiring; M I 362,.22 (yesaṃ … saṃyojanānaṃ hetu ~ī assaṃ); — agiddhilobhi(n), mfn., not greedy and covetous; M I 362,.29 (agiddhilobhissa); — see also gedhi.
gihigata:
gihi(n)
m., [S. gṛhin] (sg. gen./dat. ~ino, ~issa; pl. nom./acc. ~ī, ~ino; iic usually gihi -, occasionally gihī-), one who possesses a house, a householder; one who lives the household (worldly and sensual) life (often contrasted with pabbajita ); Abh 446 (gahatthāgārikā ~ī); Vin II 129,.15 (~ī bhikkhave maṅgalikā); M III 261,.22 (na … ~īnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ evarūpī dhammī kathā paṭibhāti); S IV 180,.18 (idha bhikkhu ~īhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~ī, read gihīsaṃsaṭṭho?); A I 69,.15 (micchāpaṭipattiṃ na vaṇṇemi ~issa vā pabbajitassa vā); III 211,.22 (~iṃ odātavasanaṃ); IV 281,.11 (mayaṃ bhante ~ī kāmabhogī puttasambādha-sayanaṃ ajjhāvasāma kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhoma mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayāma jātarūparajataṃ sādiyāma); Dhp 74; Sn 220 (~i dāraposī); Th 101 (hitvā °-tvaṃ, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce °-ttaṃ); 939 (bhesajjesu yathā vejjā kiccākicce yathā ~ī); Ja III 105,23* (alaso ~ī kāmabhogī na sādhu); VI 63,27* (yaṃ hoti cattaṃ ~ino sunakhassa vā); Ap 67,.22 (na ~ī nāpi saññato, Be, Ce so; Se ~i; Ee wr gihinā nāpi paññatto); Mil 264,.29 (yo ~ī arahattaṃ patto dve v’ assa gatiyo bhavanti anaññā tasmiṃ yeva divase pabbajati vā parinibbāyati vā); Vism 40,.18 (guṇehi pasannānaṃ ~īnaṃ santikā uppannā paccayā); Ps I 264,.19 (eko daharo [bhikkhu] hatthaṃ pasārento kāyasaṃsaggaṃ patvā ten’ eva kāraṇena ~ī jāto); Dhp-a III 257,.2 (ye ~ino … pabbajitā vā …); —      °-gata,  gihīgata,   mfn., [cf O. von Hinüber, 2008 ], associated with householders; known to householders; (f.) associated with a householder, married;? Vin II 288,.17 (sant’ amhākaṃ sikkhāpadāni ~āni gihī pi no jānanti idaṃ vo samaṇānaṃ Sakyaputtiyānaṃ kappati idaṃ vo na kappati; Sp-ṭ [Be] III 449,.24 foll. ~ānī ti gihipaṭisaṃyuttānī ti vadanti, gihīsu gatāni tehi ñātāni ~ānī ti evaṃ pan’ ettha attho daṭṭhabbo); IV 322,.2 (ūnadvādasavassā bhikkhave ~ā akkhamā hoti sītassa uṇhassa …); 322,.6 (yā pana bhikkhunī ūnadvādasa-vassaṃ ~aṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya pācittiyan ti; 322,.10 : ~ā nāma purisantaragatā vuccati); Vin-vn 2376; 2378; — neg. agihī̆gata, mfn., Sp 942,.4; —        °-(d)dhaja,   m., the emblem or characteristic sign of a householder; Vin II 22,.27 (na ~o dhāretabbo; Sp 1159,.8 foll. : odātavatthāni acchinnadasāni pupphadasāni ca na dhāretabbāni); —        °-niyāma,   m., the manner of a householder; Dhp-a I 16,.10; —       °-nivattha,   n., the kind or style of (under)garment worn by a householder; (None °-nivatthaṃ, adv., in the way a householder wears his (under)garment;) Vin II 137,.5 foll. (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ~aṃ nivāsenti hatthisoṇḍakaṃ maccha-vālakaṃ … na bhikkhave ~aṃ nivāsetabbaṃ hatthi-soṇḍakaṃ …); —       °-patirūpakara,   mfn., appropriate for householders; D III 164,2* (idha mahipatissa kāmabhogā gihipatirūpakarā bahū bhavanti, so read with vl in Ee? see K.R. Norman, 1987–88, p. 288; Be, Ce gihi-patirūpakā; Ee, Se gihīpatirūpakā); —       °-pāruta,   n., the kind or style of upper garment worn by a householder; (None °-pārutam, adv., in the way a householder wears his upper garment;) Vin II 137,.11 foll. (chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ~aṃ pārupanti … na bhikkhave ~aṃ pārupitabbaṃ; Sp 1213,.5 : parimaṇḍalalakkhaṇato aññathā pārutaṃ sabbaṃ etaṃ ~aṃ nāma); —       °-bandhana,   n., the bonds which bind a householder; Sn 44 (chetvāna vīro ~āni; Pj II 91,.23 foll. : kāmabandhanāni, kāmā hi gihīnaṃ bandhanāni) = Ap 9,.13; Ja I 9,.22 (pahīnaṃ me ~aṃ); Cp-a 133,.25 (~âbhāvaṃ dassetvā idāni pabbajitānaṃ pi kesañci yaṃ hoti bandhanaṃ tassāpi abhāvaṃ dassetuṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee gihibandhābhāvaṃ, prob. wr); —       °-liṅga,   n., the distinctive marks or appearance or character of a householder; Vin III 34,.22 (bhikkhu … ~ena methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevi; Sp 272,.13 : ~enā ti gihīvesena odātavattho hutvā); Mil 265,.14 (n’ eso mahārāja doso arahattassa ~ass’ eso doso yadidaṃ liṅgadubbalatā); Ps III 334,.14 (tāvad ev’ assa ~aṃ antaradhāyi samaṇaliṅgaṃ pāturahosi); Cp-a 283,.2 (pabbajitass’ eva patthanā samijjhati no ~e ṭhitassa); —       °-vikaṭa,   °-vikata,   mfn., (what is) produced by, belonging to, a householder;? Vin II 163,.28 (anujānāmi bhikkhave ṭhapetvā tīṇi āsandiṃ pallaṅkaṃ tūlikaṃ ~aṃ abhinisīdituṃ; Vjb [Be] 477,.16 : ~an ti gihīnaṃ atthāya kataṃ; Vmv [Be] II 240,.14 : ~an ti gihīhi kataṃ paññattaṃ, gihisantakan ti attho); Sp 1240,.22 (kaṃsa-lohavaṭṭalohabhājanavikati saṅghikaparibhogena vā ~ā vā vaṭṭati); 1241,.10 (suvaṇṇarajata-ārakūṭajātiphalika-bhājanāni ~āni pi na vaṭṭanti; cf Vin-vn 2865: siṅgisajjhumayaṃ hārakūṭajaṃ phalikubbhavaṃ bhājanāni na vaṭṭanti gihīnaṃ santakāni pi); —        °-vyañjana,   n., a distinctive sign of a householder; Sn 44 (oropayitvā ~āni; Pj II 91,.18 : kesamassu-odāta-vatthālaṅkāramālāgandhavilepanitthiputtadāsidāsādīni); Mil 11,.17 (kāmanissitāni … vatthāni kamanīyāni ~āni, Ce, Ee so; Se kammaniyāni; Be kāmanissitāni ~-bhaṇḍāni); Ps III 38,.16 (sabbān’ eva hi ~āni tassa gihibhāvaṃ pākaṭaṃ karontī ti); Vibh-a 515,.16 (~ena gahaṭṭho ahan ti); —       °-saṃyojana,   n., the fetter that binds a householder; M I 483,.6 (atthi nu kho … koci gihī ~aṃ appahāya kāyassa bhedā dukkhass’ antaṅkaro ti; Ps III 196,.4 : ~an ti °-bandhanaṃ °-parikkhāresu nikanti); Kv 267,.6 (natthi arahato ~an ti); Spk III 297,.7 (pabbajitenā ti ~aṃ chinditvā pabbajjupagatena); —       °-sāle    in Ee at Ps IV 193,.4 is wr for gihikāle (Be, Ce, Se so).

gotthu
gotthula, [= goṭṭha?]? Sadd 367,.20 (gottha vaṃse: gotthati gotthulo gotthu); 872,.12 (musalo gotthulo potthulo).

(n.) another village, a different village; the next village; Vin IV 62,.30 (yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ saṃvidhāya ekaddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya antamaso ~aṃ pi pācittiyan ti; 63,.28 : kukkuṭasampāte gāme ~e ~e āpatti pācittiyassa; Sp 806,.27 foll. : anantaragāmassa upacārokkamane pana bhikkhuno pācittiyaṃ); 227,.33 (bhikkhunī ekā ~aṃ gacchatī ti); Sp 807,.21 (~e cetiyavandanatthaṃ gāmato nikkhamantaṃ bhikkhuṃ disvā); Ps II 258,.21 (dve tīṇi ~āni vā aṭaviṃ vā vicaranto); Vin-vn 2033 (~aṃ nadīpāraṃ gaccheyy’ ekā); — 2.
